# Ashif Ahmed Shuvo — Research Portfolio

> Personal research portfolio of Ashif Ahmed Shuvo, an AI and machine learning researcher working on
> computer vision, remote sensing and data-driven precision agriculture. Based in Bangladesh,
> affiliated with Bangladesh Agricultural University (BSc Food Engineering, MSc AgroMeteorology in progress).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/): introduction, research focus and recent activity.
- [About](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/about): background, research direction and goals.
- [Skills](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/skills): programming languages, frameworks, analysis methods and domain expertise.
- [Experience](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/experience): research and industry roles, education, certificates.
- [Publications](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/publications): peer-reviewed papers and writings with abstracts and impact factors.
- [Projects](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/projects): open-source repositories, fetched live from GitHub.
- [Research Feed](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/feed): short updates published through Bluesky.
- [Contact](https://myself-aas.github.io/me/contact): collaboration and speaking enquiries.
